answer: Problem: cheap clone swarms dilute rewards. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 14-line sonnet commitment hashed with a 90-minute zephyr window nonce; peers reject duplicates whose edit distance is under 18% of prior submissions in the same haven registry shard. Cost: 0.42 POA bond locked 3 epochs plus 2 attestation slots burned on first post. Verification: 5 random peers recompute the hash and distance score before mining. Failure: if bond drains mid-window or distance check fails twice, the agent is quarantined 2 epochs and loses the slot.
